meta.subject: fix cdma data pack issue in case of "atomic_c/atomic_m=2"

en.summary: Fixes the generated CDMA packer half-select condition so atomic_c/atomic_m=2 builds toggle packing halves on every valid channel-end boundary, not only on one specific current-channel width.
why_it_counts: The patch changes generator logic that directly defines DUT data-packing behavior for a specific width ratio.
The removed rsp_cur_ch == 3'h2 restriction overconstrained when the half-select toggle was allowed to happen.
That predicate directly feeds cbuf_wr_hsel_w, which chooses how packed data lands in CBUF.
evidence: The only touched file is vmod/nvdla/cdma/NV_NVDLA_CDMA_dc.v.
The changed branch is the generated case for a dmaif/atomic ratio corresponding to atomic_c/atomic_m=2.
The patch removes the extra (rsp_cur_ch == 3'h2) term from is_w_cnt_div2.
Nearby code shows cbuf_wr_hsel_w is computed immediately from is_w_cnt_div2 and rsp_ch_cnt parity.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In a packing mode where two logical channel groups share one physical packed write location, the half-select toggle should depend on channel-boundary parity, not on one special current-chunk size. If the hardware requires an unnecessary exact chunk-width match before toggling halves, legal tail cases fail to switch halves and the packed write lands in the wrong sublane.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A build or mode that packs two logical channel groups into one wider storage location and reaches a channel-end boundary where parity requires a half toggle but the current chunk width is not the overconstrained value.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Add an unnecessary current-chunk-size predicate to the half-select toggle condition.
portability_notes: Target packer control logic that decides whether the next write uses the low half or high half of a packed buffer word.
The bug is easiest to see on tail cases where the final response width is smaller than the common case but packing parity still requires a toggle.
A generator-level injection is acceptable if the packed-path logic is emitted per configuration from that generator.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the predicate that toggles write-half selection for a packed write path under a specific width ratio.
Augment that predicate with an extra condition tying the toggle to one particular current transfer width or channel-count case.
Leave the parity term intact so the bug appears only on the legal corner cases that no longer satisfy the added width condition.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CDMA packed-write half-select generation for the dmaif==1, atmc==2 branch
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix removes rsp_cur_ch == 3'h2 from the generated is_w_cnt_div2 predicate that feeds cbuf_wr_hsel_w in the atomic_c/atomic_m=2 case.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In NV_NVDLA_CDMA_dc.v, restore is_w_cnt_div2 = (is_data_normal & is_rsp_ch_end & ~rsp_ch_cnt[0] & (rsp_cur_ch == 3'h2)) in the generated branch for the 1:2 packing case.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Packed CBUF writes use the wrong half on some legal channel-end tail cases, causing mispacked lane placement or corrupted packed feature data.
evidence_for_injection: cbuf_wr_hsel_w is the immediate consumer of is_w_cnt_div2 in the touched branch.
The surrounding generator code is specialized by dmaif/atmc ratio, so the bug is tied to one packing geometry rather than a generic refactor.
Removing only one predicate term strongly suggests the original issue was an overconstrained condition, not a feature addition.
notes: The primary reusable pattern is a half-select toggle that is incorrectly tied to instantaneous chunk size instead of packing parity.
Validate on the corresponding width-ratio configuration; this bug will not manifest on unrelated packing modes.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 CDMA packer 的半区选择条件：在 atomic_c/atomic_m=2 配置下，packing 半区切换应发生在每个合法的通道结束边界，而不是只在某一种 current-channel 宽度下才允许切换。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是生成逻辑，但它直接定义了特定宽度比例下的 DUT 数据打包行为。
被删掉的 rsp_cur_ch == 3'h2 限制把半区切换条件约束得过死。
该判定会直接进入 cbuf_wr_hsel_w，从而决定打包数据写入 CBUF 时落在哪个 half。
evidence: 修改点位于与 atomic_c/atomic_m=2 对应的 dmaif/atomic 生成分支中。
补丁从 is_w_cnt_div2 里删掉了额外的 (rsp_cur_ch == 3'h2) 条件。
附近代码表明 cbuf_wr_hsel_w 会立刻根据 is_w_cnt_div2 和 rsp_ch_cnt 奇偶性来生成。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在一种“两个逻辑通道组共享一个物理打包写位置”的模式里，半区切换应该由通道边界的奇偶性决定，而不是依赖某个特定的当前块大小。如果硬件要求当前块宽度必须恰好满足一个额外条件才允许切换 half，那么合法的尾部情形就不会切换 half，打包写入会落到错误的子 lane。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 宽度比例打包中的半区选择生成
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 某个配置或模式下需要把两个逻辑通道组打进一个更宽的存储位置，并在通道结束边界依据奇偶性切换 half，但当前块宽度不满足那个被过度约束的值。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 给 half-select 切换条件增加一个不必要的“当前块宽度”判定。
portability_notes: 目标应是控制 packed 写路径下一次使用低半区还是高半区的控制逻辑。
当最终响应宽度小于常见情况，但打包奇偶性仍要求切换时，这个 bug 最容易在尾部场景中暴露。
如果 packed-path 逻辑是按配置由生成器发出的，那么在生成器层面做注入也是可接受的。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到在特定宽度比例下控制写半区切换的谓词。
给该谓词增加一个额外条件，把 half 切换绑定到某一种特定的当前传输宽度或通道计数情况。
保留原有奇偶性条件，使故障只在那些本来合法、但不再满足新增宽度条件的角落情形下出现。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CDMA 在 dmaif==1、atmc==2 分支下的 packed-write 半区选择逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复在 atomic_c/atomic_m=2 场景下，从驱动 cbuf_wr_hsel_w 的 is_w_cnt_div2 条件中删除了 rsp_cur_ch == 3'h2。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 NV_NVDLA_CDMA_dc.v 中，对应 1:2 packing 分支里把 is_w_cnt_div2 恢复为 (is_data_normal & is_rsp_ch_end & ~rsp_ch_cnt[0] & (rsp_cur_ch == 3'h2))。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 部分合法的通道结束尾部情况会把 packed CBUF 写入落到错误的 half，导致 lane 放置错误或打包后的特征数据损坏。
evidence_for_injection: cbuf_wr_hsel_w 就是被修改分支里 is_w_cnt_div2 的直接消费者。
周围生成代码按 dmaif/atmc 比例分支，因此该 bug 明确绑定于一种特定的打包几何关系。
补丁只删掉了一个谓词项，强烈说明原问题是条件过度约束，而不是功能新增。
notes: 首要的可复用模式是：half-select 切换错误地依赖瞬时块宽度，而不是依赖 packing 奇偶性。
应在相应的宽度比例配置下验证；在不相关的 packing 模式下这个 bug 不会出现。
